title: Repair and hand-test a chain drive
instruction: Reconnect the open drive chain around the two sprockets. Insert the orange connecting link up through both chain-end holes and secure its pins with the blue retaining plate. Use the hand crank to move the repaired link once all the way around both sprockets, without disconnecting or derailing the chain. Then release both hands. The drive is unpowered.
context: An unpowered maintenance task that must establish both a retained connection and motion transmission. This implementation is unfinished and is not a submission.
setup: Standard calibrated bimanual YAM station. Eleven 100mm-pitch rigid links lie around two freely rotating six-tooth training sprockets at (0.30,0) and (0.60,0)m, in plane z=0.900m, above a service deck at z=0.879m. The missing twelfth link is at the front. An orange 200g upward-pin connecting link with a 45x140x6mm backing starts at (0.30,-0.26,0.950)m. A blue 75g keeper, 44x136x6mm with 24mm slots and a short in-plane tab, starts at (0.18,0.20,0.917)m. A 35mm-radius hand crank operates the front passive axle. Fixed guides, supports, pickup stands, all primitive dimensions and nominal materials are listed in setup-layout.json and scene-inventory.json. No current final screenshot or demo is available.
scoring: Proposed current-state score: 0 for disconnected or derailed chain, invalid state or workspace escape; 0.4 for both ends on their stems; 0.7 additionally for the keeper covering both stems. Full 1.0 additionally requires continuous physical retention/routing through one repaired-link circuit, approximately two revolutions of each axle with phase error <=0.15rad, then one second settled with both hands open and clear. Exact thresholds and history-reset conditions are in scoring.py. No full-score native demonstration exists.
reset_notes: Restore the fixed layout and passive joints, open grippers at ready, settle 0.5s, then begin scoring.
fidelity: Unfinished native rigid-contact training drive with ten passive chain hinges, two passive sprocket axles and a passive crank-knob bearing. Compact joint circulation currently binds. Low-friction service bed and lubricated chain/sprocket contact. No task-body writes after reset, software latches, collision changes, powered operation, rated load, wear or fracture model.
scores: Unfinished functional-drive revision; no valid full-score demo or matching Dream-1 episode.
